Logos on Android

Decentralised, anonymous radio for Android over Tor + Logos Messaging — Booth (broadcast a station) and Receiver (discover & listen). Self-hosted, no Google.

Currently it serves 2 apps. To add it to your F-Droid app, scan the QR code (click it to enlarge) or use this link:

https://xalisher.github.io/fdroid/repo
